# 2. Pathway Timing -- Median Timing
```{r}
# Process the data
LOH_MSI_type <- LOH_MSI %>% filter(MSI_mut == "MSS") %>% dplyr::select(aliquot_id, histology_abbreviation)
cell_types_order <- c("MHCregulators", "Tcells", "NKcells", "Macrophages", "GammadeltaTcells")
cell_types_order <- rev(cell_types_order)
regulator_order  <- c("Pos", "Neg")
regulator_order  <- rev(regulator_order)
scaling_factor   <- 2.5  

diff_all <- fread(paste0(path_MutationTiming, "/min_drivermutation_250/diff_all.csv"))

pathway_selected <- diff_all %>%
  group_by(pathway) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(count >= 40) %>%
  pull(pathway)

summary_df <- diff_all %>%
  group_by(histology_abbreviation, pathway) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(median_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    lower95 = quantile(median_value, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    upper95 = quantile(median_value, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(median_value)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

data_bin <- diff_all %>%
  filter(pathway %in% pathway_selected) %>%
  group_by(pathway, histology_abbreviation) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  inner_join(., diff_all, by = c("histology_abbreviation", "pathway")) %>%
  mutate(n_base = 1,
         percent_base = n_base/count,
         timing_bin = cut(median_value, breaks = range_breaks_median, include.lowest = TRUE),
         regulator = ifelse(regulator == "pos", "Pos", "Neg")) %>% 
  arrange(desc(count))

slice_cols <- levels(data_bin$timing_bin)

# default timing_bin palette if not provided
if (is.null(color_vector)) {
  pal <- grDevices::hcl.colors(length(slice_cols), "Set3")
  names(pal) <- slice_cols
  color_vector <- pal
}

# ======================
# Filter + set orders (keep only Pos/Neg regulators; drop "other" celltype)
# ======================
data_all <- data_bin %>%
  filter(regulator %in% regulator_order) %>%
  mutate(
    celltype  = factor(celltype,  levels = cell_types_order),
    regulator = factor(regulator, levels = regulator_order)
  )

# ======================
# Order pathways by celltype -> regulator -> count (desc) -> pathway
# ======================
order_tbl <- data_all %>%
  group_by(celltype, regulator, pathway) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(celltype, regulator, desc(pathway))

y_levels <- unique(order_tbl$pathway)

data_all <- data_all %>%
  mutate(pathway = factor(pathway, levels = y_levels))

# ======================
# Prepare colored y-axis labels: color each pathway by its dominant celltype
# ======================
pathway_colors_map <- order_tbl %>%
  group_by(pathway) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(color = dplyr::case_when(
    celltype == "MHCregulators"    ~ "#1E90FF",
    celltype == "Tcells"           ~ "#00CD66",
    celltype == "NKcells"          ~ "#191970",
    celltype == "Macrophages"      ~ "orange",
    celltype == "GammadeltaTcells" ~ "#008B8B",
    TRUE ~ "black"
  ))

# vector of colors aligned to pathway factor levels
y_label_colors <- pathway_colors_map$color[
  match(levels(data_all$pathway), pathway_colors_map$pathway)
]

# colored HTML labels for ggtext
y_labels_colored <- paste0(
  "<span style='color:", y_label_colors, "'>",
  levels(data_all$pathway),
  "</span>"
)

data_wide <- data_all %>% 
  filter(histology_abbreviation != "Cervix-AdenoCA") %>%
  add_count(histology_abbreviation, pathway, name = "count_all") %>%
  filter(count_all > 1) %>%
  dplyr::count(histology_abbreviation, pathway, timing_bin, name = "count") %>%
  mutate(timing_bin = factor(timing_bin, levels = slice_cols)) %>%
  tidyr::complete(histology_abbreviation, pathway, timing_bin, fill = list(count = 0)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timing_bin, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway, histology_abbreviation, all_of(slice_cols)) %>%
  mutate(total = rowSums(across(all_of(slice_cols)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  left_join(freq_sucess, by = "histology_abbreviation") %>%
  mutate(total_n = total / Freq,
         histology_abbreviation = paste0(histology_abbreviation, " (n = ", Freq, ")"))

x_levels <- unique(data_wide$histology_abbreviation)
y_levels <- unique(data_wide$pathway)

data_pies <- data_wide %>% 
  pivot_longer(all_of(slice_cols), names_to = "timing_bin", values_to = "count") %>%
  filter(count > 0) %>%
  group_by(histology_abbreviation, pathway) %>%
  mutate(
    fraction = count / sum(count),
    end   = cumsum(fraction) * 2 * pi,
    start = lag(end, default = 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    x = as.numeric(factor(histology_abbreviation, levels = x_levels)),
    y = as.numeric(factor(pathway, levels = y_levels)),
    radius = sqrt(total_n / pi) * scaling_factor
  )

# ======================
# Manual size legend (values you care about)
# ======================
legend_values <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4)

legend_data <- data.frame(
  total_n = legend_values,
  radius = sqrt(legend_values / pi) * scaling_factor,
  x = seq(from = min(data_pies$x, na.rm = TRUE),
          length.out = length(legend_values),
          by = 1),
  y = max(data_pies$y, na.rm = TRUE) + 3
)

# ======================
# Plot
# ======================
p <- ggplot(data_pies) +
  ggforce::geom_arc_bar(
    aes(
      x0 = x, y0 = y,
      r0 = 0, r = radius, # Keep radius unchanged
      start = start, end = end,
      fill = timing_bin
    ),
    color = NA, # Add white borders for segment distinction
    size = 0, # Thicker border to separate segments
    alpha = 1 # Slightly higher alpha for vivid colors
  ) +
  ggforce::geom_circle(
    data = legend_data,
    aes(x0 = x, y0 = y, r = radius),
    color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = legend_data,
    aes(x = x + 0.4, y = y, label = total_n),
    hjust = 0, size = 3
  ) + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = unique(data_pies$x),
    labels = unique(data_pies$histology_abbreviation),
    expand = c(0, 0.2)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(levels(data_all$pathway)),
    labels = y_labels_colored,
    expand = c(0, 0.8)
  ) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1, clip = "on") + # Perfect circles
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_vector_median) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Timing Bin") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, b = 10, l = 5, r = 5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 10, v = 0.5, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 10, margin = margin(r = 4)),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) 

# Save
ggsave(paste0(path_figure, "/Figure4A.pdf"), p, width = 10, height = 12, units = "in")
```
